meta.description: Uno, an L298N module, two gear motors, an eight-sensor reflectance array and an IMU on a two-wheel chassis with a caster. Drives round a closed track in the physics arena. Part numbers and physics numbers are example values.
meta.title: Two-wheel line follower

faults.note: Weak pack: the Uno resets when both motors start.
Swaps the left motor leads: the robot steers away from the line.
Lifts the sensor array 15 mm: the reflectance contrast fades.

checks.label: Battery stays between 6.0 V and 8.4 V

tests.name: Runs a lap without a reset
